name: bringup-d2-scan
about: Bring-up matrix row scan (D2): VAP up, ONE nl80211 scan request (iw dev wlan0 scan) and the D2H scan-event watch. PASS gate for the frame-validity phase = scan request accepted (rc=0) + no firmware exception (mask 0/staging 0) + no H2D timeout/refusal. DOCUMENTED BLOCKED state: the fail-closed cfg80211 M2 scan stub returns -EOPNOTSUPP (iw rc=161, 'Not supported (-95)') - the scan step records BLOCKED, the session continues, and the phase matrix reports BLOCKED-DRIVER (not ERROR/FAIL) until the wifi-vap-scan g0 id0xC provider builder lands. The D2H g1 15/16/17 / g2 2 events are WATCH-ONLY (host-only M1 VAP; firmware scan handler CA 0x6494C hardcodes VAP lookup id 0, a graceful no-VAP refusal with no events is accepted).

steps.name: cfg-status
steps.about: wiphy registered after the ready handshake

steps.name: link-up
steps.about: bring the managed netdev up; nl80211 refuses scan requests on a down interface

steps.name: scan-baseline
steps.about: D2H catalogue before the scan request (delta baseline for the result events)

steps.name: scan
steps.about: ONE nl80211 scan request: g0 id0xC hmac_enc_scan_send_req (0x1FC B struct; payload builder is the scan lane's deliverable). DOCUMENTED BLOCKED OUTCOME: while the cfg80211 scan op is the fail-closed -EOPNOTSUPP stub, iw exits non-zero (rc=161/-95, output 'Not supported (-95)') - that is the expected BLOCKED-DRIVER state, not a failure: the step records BLOCKED, the session continues and reports SESSION_RESULT: BLOCKED:scan. The step turns PASS once the provider forwards a real scan request (rc=0).
blocked_patterns: scan needs an H2D frame provider

steps.name: scan-settle
steps.about: bounded wait for the firmware scan events to reach the direct reader

steps.name: post-scan-pack
steps.about: the scan request did not fault the firmware: exception mask and staging stay clean (frame validity)

steps.name: h2d-summary
steps.about: the scan H2D node was consumed (no timeout) and no store was refused

steps.name: scan-events-watch
steps.about: WATCH-ONLY: capture the D2H catalogue after the scan. The vendor event family is g1 ids 15/16/17 + g2 id2 (wifi-vap-scan REPORT section 6); with the host-only M1 VAP the firmware may gracefully refuse (no .12/.26 events) - accepted for this phase, the evidence is captured for the next revision.

steps.name: note-end
steps.about: D2 row PASS = scan request accepted (rc=0) + no exception (mask 0/staging 0) + H2D timeout=0/refused=0; D2H events are watch-only. rc=95 is the known fail-closed provider/M2 stub (BLOCKED-DRIVER), any other rc is a real failure - never retry on the same boot.
